## Notes

A saved cursor is historical process state, not proof current reality is unchanged. Campaign/Commitment estimates are forecasts, not promises. Buildability may reopen when newly discovered material evidence changes what must be decided. If a Build Room handoff exists, never recommend repeating the same implementation assignment until live repository/evidence has been checked for a result.
